# Japan Experience

> > Comprehensive travel guide to Japan covering temples, shrines, onsen, seasonal attractions, and cultural experiences across Tokyo, Kyoto, Hokkaido, and beyond.

Japan Experience provides detailed destination guides, cultural insights, and practical travel information for exploring Japan's regions, from UNESCO World Heritage sites like Todaiji Temple to seasonal experiences like cherry blossom viewing and hydrangea festivals. The site covers historical periods including the Edo era, major cities, natural hot springs, and traditional customs.

## Key Topics

- Cherry blossoms (hanami)
- Tokyo parks and gardens
- Kyoto temples and shrines
- Onsen and hot springs
- World Heritage sites
- Japanese Buddhism
- Hokkaido travel
- Seasonal flowers (hydrangeas, sakura)
- Edo period history
- Toyotomi Hideyoshi
- Kannon statues
- Tohoku region
- Traditional festivals (matsuri)
- Okinawa
- Sapporo

## Temples and Shrines

- [Todaiji Temple](https://www.japan-experience.com/all-about-japan/todaiji-temple): Todaiji Temple Nara: UNESCO site with Great Buddha & wooden architecture
- [Sanjusangendo](https://www.japan-experience.com/all-about-japan/kyoto/temples-and-shrines-in-japan/sanjusangendo): Sanjusangendo Temple Kyoto guide with 1001 Kannon statues
- [Daigoji Temple](https://www.japan-experience.com/all-about-japan/kyoto/temples-shrines/daigoji): Daigoji Temple Kyoto: World Heritage site with five-story pagoda
- [Senjafuda: maps of the 1000 temples](https://www.japan-experience.com/plan-your-trip/to-know/understanding-japan/senjafuda-maps-of-the-1000-temples): Explanation of Senjafuda temple pilgrimage prayer slips tradition
- [The rakan, the greatest disciples of Buddha](https://www.japan-experience.com/plan-your-trip/to-know/understanding-japan/the-rakan-the-greatest-disciples-of-buddha): Explanation of rakan (arhat) Buddhist disciples in Zen Buddhism

## Tokyo Attractions and Neighborhoods

- [Yoyogi Koen](https://www.japan-experience.com/all-about-japan/tokyo/parks-and-gardens/yoyogi-koen): Yoyogi Park Tokyo guide near Meiji Jingu Shrine with cherry blossoms
- [Daikanyama](https://www.japan-experience.com/all-about-japan/tokyo/attractions-excursions/daikanyama-area): Daikanyama Tokyo neighborhood guide near Shibuya with boutiques & cafes
- [Eisei Bunko Museum](https://www.japan-experience.com/all-about-japan/tokyo/museums-galleries/eisei-bunko-museum): Eisei Bunko Museum showcasing Hosokawa Clan art & samurai collection
- [Where to admire hydrangeas in Tokyo?](https://www.japan-experience.com/all-about-japan/tokyo/attractions-and-excursions/where-to-admire-hydrangeas-in-tokyo): Guide to viewing hydrangeas at Hakusan shrine & Tokyo parks during June
- [The city of Kumagaya](https://www.japan-experience.com/all-about-japan/tokyo/attractions-and-excursions/the-city-of-kumagaya): Kumagaya city guide with Shodenzan Temple & Uchiwa Matsuri festival

## Onsen and Hot Springs

- [The best onsen in the Tohoku region](https://www.japan-experience.com/plan-your-trip/to-know/travelling-in-japan-a-comprehensive-guide/the-best-onsen-in-the-tohoku-region): Selection of top hot springs in Tohoku including Sukayu & Zao Onsen
- [Yufuin](https://www.japan-experience.com/all-about-japan/beppu/onsen-public-baths/yufuin): Yufuin onsen resort guide near Beppu with Kinrinko Lake & ryokan

## Seasonal Experiences and Cherry Blossoms

- [The 8 Best Places to see Cherry Blossoms in Hokkaido](https://www.japan-experience.com/all-about-japan/sapporo/attractions-and-excursions/where-to-see-cherry-blossoms-in-hokkaido): Top 8 hanami spots in Hokkaido including Maruyama & Nakajima Parks

## Hokkaido and Northern Japan

- [Mount Yotei](https://www.japan-experience.com/all-about-japan/sapporo/attractions-and-excursions/mount-yotei): Mount Yotei Hokkaido hiking guide with four trails near Niseko
- [Sado Island Guide](https://www.japan-experience.com/all-about-japan/nagano/attractions-and-excursions/sado-island-guide): Sado Island travel guide: gold mine, Kodo drummers & temples near Niigata

## Regional Travel and Transportation

- [Public transportation in Osaka?](https://www.japan-experience.com/decouvrir/osaka/attractions-excursions/les-transports-en-commun-a-osaka): Osaka public transit guide: subway, metro lines & IC cards
- [Japanese service stations](https://www.japan-experience.com/plan-your-trip/to-know/japanese-service-stations): Guide to Japanese gas stations with service etiquette & fuel vocabulary

## Optional

- [The Popular Festivals of Mie Prefecture](https://www.japan-experience.com/all-about-japan/ise/events-festivals/the-major-festivals-of-the-prefecture-of-mie): Mie Prefecture matsuri guide featuring Ishidori Matsuri in Kuwana
- [Olympic Games 2020 - Martial Arts](https://www.japan-experience.com/all-about-japan/tokyo/events-festivals/olympic-games-2020-martial-arts): Tokyo 2020 Olympics martial arts guide: judo, karate & taekwondo events
- [Pachinko arcade](https://www.japan-experience.com/plan-your-trip/to-know/understanding-japan/pachinko-arcade): Understanding pachinko gambling culture & arcade machines in Japan
